strings.greeting: Su'aal ka weydii casharkan. Jawaabtu waxay ka imanaysaa qoraalka casharka.
strings.cloudConsent: Ikhtiyaar: haddii la calaamadiyo, su'aashaada iyo qaybta casharka ee la helay waxaa loo diri karaa AI-ga daruuraha ee goobtan loo habeeyey. Haddii aan la calaamadin, raadinta casharka ayaa la adeegsanayaa.
strings.errorEmpty: Geli su'aal ka hor intaadan dirin.
strings.listening: Aqoonsiga hadalka ayaa dhegaysanaya. Dib u eeg erayada ka hor dirista.
strings.recording: Farriin cod ah ayaan u duubayaa macallinka. Looma dirayo kaaliyaha.
strings.recordedReady: Farriinta codku waa diyaar. Macallinka oo keliya ayaa loo diri doonaa.
strings.speechAdded: Hadalkaaga waxaa lagu daray su'aasha. Dib u eeg ka hor dirista.
strings.voiceUnavailable: Aqoonsiga hadalku ma shaqayn, duubista codkuna lama heli karo.
strings.speechLimitations: Aqoonsiga hadalka iyo codadku waxay ku xiran yihiin biraawsarkaaga, qalabkaaga iyo luqadda la doortay. Dib u eeg erayada la aqoonsaday ka hor dirista.
strings.noSpeechVoice: Qalabkan kama jiro cod ku hadlaya luqadda la doortay.
strings.voiceNote: Farriin cod ah oo macallinka loo dirayo
strings.escalationSent: Codsigaaga safka ayaa la geliyey. Macallimiintu way maqnaan karaan, xataa 23:00. Waqtiga jawaabtu wuu kala duwan yahay, mana jiro dammaanad. Halkan ku soo noqo oo dooro Hubi jawaabta macallinka.
strings.tutorAvailability: Macallimiintu way maqnaan karaan, xataa 23:00. Codsiyada safka ayaa la geliyaa, laakiin waqtiga jawaabtu wuu kala duwan yahay, mana jiro dammaanad. Halkan ku soo noqo oo dooro Hubi jawaabta macallinka.
strings.tutorReplyPending: Weli jawaab ma jirto. Codsigaagu weli wuu sugayaa. Mar dambe dib u hubi.
strings.tutorUpdateAvailable: Macallin ayaa cusboonaysiin soo diray. Codsigaagu weli wuu furan yahay; mar dambe hubi jawaabta kama dambaysta ah.
strings.tutorReplyAvailable: Macallin ayaa jawaabay. Jawaabta waxaa lagu muujiyey wada sheekaysigan.
strings.checkTutorReplyFailed: Lama hubin karin jawaabta macallinka. Hubi isku xirkaaga oo mar kale isku day.
strings.ticketDataFailed: Lama maamuli karin codsigan. Hubi isku xirkaaga oo mar kale isku day.
strings.ticketDataDeleteConfirm: Ma rabtaa inaad si joogto ah u tirtirto codsigan macallinka iyo lifaaqyadiisa?
strings.ticketDataNote: Biraawsarkani wuxuu kaydiyaa furaha gaarka ah ee dhoofinta iyo tirtirista codsiga. Xogta biraawsarkaaga si gaar ah u ilaali.
strings.clearLocalDataConfirm: Ma nadiifinaysaa taariikhda wada sheekaysiga, su'aalaha safka ku jira, xogta casharka ee kaydsan iyo furayaasha codsiga biraawsarkan? Tani ma tirtirayso codsiyada server-ka.
strings.clearLocalDataDone: Xogta kaaliyaha ee biraawsarka waa la nadiifiyey. Codsiyada server-ku way jiraan haddii aanad kor ku tirtirin.
strings.clearLocalDataFailed: Lama nadiifin karin xogta biraawsarkan. Isticmaal dejimaha xogta goobta ee biraawsarka.
strings.escalationFailed: Codsigaaga lama diri karin. Hubi isku xirkaaga oo mar kale isku day.
strings.offlineSaved: Telefoonkan ayaa lagu kaydiyey. Marka aad internet hesho ayaa la diri doonaa.
strings.phoneInvalid: Geli lambar Itoobiyaan ah oo ku bilaabma 09, 07, +2519 ama +2517.
strings.accommodationButton: Waxaan u baahanahay habayn wareysiga shaqada
strings.accommodationPrivacy: Doorashada habayntaada iyo qoraalkaagu waxay u socdaan macallinka oo keliya. Lala wadaagi maayo loo-shaqeeye.
strings.whichJob: Shaqadee tijaabo ah ayaad wareysigeeda galay?
strings.whichAccommodation: Habayn noocee ah ayaa ku caawin lahayd?
strings.accommodationSent: Codsigaaga si gaar ah ayaa macallin loogu diray.
strings.accommodationFailed: Codsigaaga lama diri karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
strings.screenShareConsent: Waxaan oggolahay inaan macallin la wadaago shaashaddayda ama faahfaahinta bogga. Wadaagistu waxay bilaabmaysaa oo keliya marka aan badhanka riixo. Fiidiyow toos ah lama duubo ama lama kaydiyo; URL-ka bogga, magaca iyo HTML-ka qaybta la doortay, cinwaannada bogga, iyo sawir-shaashadeed kasta oo aan doorto waxaa lagu daraa codsiga macallinka.
strings.screenShareNote: HTTPS ayaa loo baahan yahay si shaashad loo wadaago. Kombiyuutarku wuxuu adeegsadaa WebRTC toos ah oo demo ah; STUN/TURN relay lama habayn, sidaas darteed shabakadaha qaarkood way xannibi karaan. Android Chrome wuxuu diraa faahfaahinta bogga iyo sawir ikhtiyaari ah oo keliya, ma aha fiidiyow toos ah.
strings.screenShareConnecting: Macallinka ayaa la sugayaa inuu ku xirmo (gaadiid demo ah).
strings.screenShareConnected: Waxaad ku xiran tahay macallinka. Fiidiyow toos ah lama duubo.
strings.screenSharePermissionDenied: Oggolaanshaha shaashadda lama bixin. Hubi rukhsadaha biraawsarkaaga.
strings.screenShareDisconnected: Xiriirkii shaashaddu wuu go'ay. Weli waad joojin kartaa wadaagista.
strings.screenShareError: Wadaagista shaashaddu ma bilaabmin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
strings.screenContextSent: Faahfaahinta bogga macallinka ayaa loo diray. Shaashadda tooska ah lama wadaagin.
strings.screenContextFailed: Faahfaahinta bogga lama diri karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
strings.screenShareCleanupFailed: Wadaagista shaashaddu way joogsatay, laakiin calaamadaha demo-ga lama nadiifin karin.
strings.translationUnavailable: Turjumaaddan lama soo shubi karin. Ingiriis ayaa la muujinayaa.
strings.describeOther: Qoraalka ku sharax habaynta aad u baahan tahay.
